templates.title: Find of the day
templates.summary: One find held up to the lens, where it hung, the label, the price tag and why it is coming home.

steps.title: The find
steps.position: In the aisle, the find in your hand
steps.direction: Hold the find at arm's length, then bring it slowly toward the lens with the tag showing.

captions.script: Found this today, and wait until you see the price on the tag.
Find of the day, and I almost walked right past it.
Look at this piece before I tell you what it costs.

steps.title: Where it was
steps.position: At the rail or shelf it came from
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, slide slowly along the rail or shelf and stop where the find was.

captions.script: It was hiding on this rail between all the other pieces.
This is the rail, so dig all the way to the back.

steps.title: The label
steps.position: Same spot, the find in your hands
steps.direction: Phone above your hands, show the label, the stitching or the maker's mark. Hold still, then flick the phone right.

captions.script: Check the label first, that is how you know it is a good one.
Look at the stitching on this, up close.

steps.title: The price
steps.position: Same spot, the tag in your fingers
steps.direction: Start mid-flick, stop on the price tag and hold it still so the price reads.

captions.script: And the price, right here on the tag, is the best part.
This is the whole price, right here on the tag.

steps.title: Why it is a find
steps.position: In the aisle, holding the find
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, with the find in frame. Say why it is a find.
steps.prompter: Good label, no damage, my size, so this one is coming home.

captions.script: Good label, no damage, my size, so this one is coming home.
For this price I would buy two if they had my size.

steps.title: Find the shop
steps.position: Outside, across from the shop sign
steps.direction: Phone low, start on the sign and tilt down slowly to the door.

captions.script: This is the shop, and here is where to find it.
Go dig through it yourself, and see what is new.

templates.title: Try-on
templates.summary: Pick a piece off the rail, show the tag, pull the curtain on the fit, try a second piece and pick one.

steps.title: The pick
steps.position: At the rail, reaching in
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, reach in with your free hand and pull one piece off the rail toward the lens.

captions.script: Pulled this off the rail, let's see how it actually fits.
Two pieces, one changing room, let's go.

steps.title: Fabric and tag
steps.position: Same spot, the piece in your hand
steps.direction: Phone above the piece, show the fabric, then the tag with the price. Hold still.

captions.script: Here is the fabric, and here is the price on the tag.
Here is what it's made of, and the price is right there.

steps.title: Changing room
steps.position: Outside your changing room
steps.direction: Walk slowly up to your changing room curtain until it fills the screen.

captions.script: Okay, into the changing room, wish me luck.
Moment of truth, does it fit or not.

steps.title: The fit
steps.position: Inside, phone propped low facing the curtain
steps.direction: Prop the phone low on the bench facing the curtain, then pull it open in the outfit and turn once.

captions.script: And here is the fit, and the colour is better than on the hanger.
Look one, and I did not expect this to work.

steps.title: Second piece
steps.position: In front of the changing room mirror
steps.direction: Phone at chest height in the mirror, in the second piece, turn once slowly. Keep the phone out of the reflection if you can.

captions.script: Look two, with the price on screen, and this one surprised me.
Second pick from the same rail, with the price on screen.

steps.title: My pick
steps.position: Outside the changing room
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, holding both pieces. Say which one you are taking.
steps.prompter: Here is the one I'm taking, and why I will actually wear it.

captions.script: Here is the one I'm taking, and why I will actually wear it.
Honestly I want both, but here is the one I am taking.

steps.title: The shop
steps.position: Outside, across from the shop sign
steps.direction: Phone low, start on the sign and tilt down slowly to the door.

captions.script: Find it right here, the shop name is on screen.
This is where I got both, go try them on.

templates.title: Budget challenge
templates.summary: A set budget, three picks with their prices, the total at the till and everything laid out together.

steps.title: The budget
steps.position: At the shop door
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the door behind you. Say the budget.
steps.prompter: I have fifty dollars and one shop, let's see what I find.

captions.script: I have fifty dollars and one shop, let's see what I find.
Fifty dollars, one shop, let's see how far it goes.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.position: At the first rail or shelf
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, reach in and bring the first pick toward the lens, tag showing.

captions.script: Pick one, and the price is right on the tag.
First find, and it already looks like a deal.

steps.title: Pick two
steps.position: Along the next shelf or rail
steps.direction: Slide slowly along the shelf, stop on the second pick, hold, then flick the phone right.

captions.script: Pick two, and here is the price on the tag.
Still under budget, and here is the second pick.

steps.title: Pick three
steps.position: At the counter, the third pick laid down
steps.direction: Start mid-flick, stop above the third pick on the counter and hold it with the tag showing.

captions.script: Pick three, and this one decides if I stay under.
Last one, and I really hope the maths works out.

steps.title: The total
steps.position: Behind the cashier's shoulder, with their okay
steps.direction: Ask the cashier first. Film over their shoulder as they ring it up and move in slowly to the total.

captions.script: Here is the total at the till, under fifty dollars.
Did I make it under budget? Look at the screen.

steps.title: The haul
steps.position: At a table or the floor, standing above
steps.direction: Lay all three picks out, start straight above one tag and lift the phone slowly so all three appear.

captions.script: All three together, and this is everything I got for fifty.
The full haul, with the price of each on screen.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: Outside the shop, bag in hand
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, holding the bag. Give your verdict.
steps.prompter: Three pieces, under fifty, and here is the one worth the trip.

captions.script: Three pieces, under fifty, and here is the one worth the trip.
Would I do it again here? Yes, and with less money.

templates.title: Owner's pick
templates.summary: The owner pulls the one piece they would keep, says why, and you try it on with the price on screen.

steps.title: The ask
steps.position: At the counter, facing the owner
steps.direction: Back camera on the owner at the counter, front camera on you. Move in slowly as you ask.
steps.prompter: I asked the owner to pick one thing in this shop for me.

captions.script: I asked the owner to pick one thing in this shop for me.
Asked the owner to choose for me, I have no say today.

steps.title: The pull
steps.position: Behind the owner's shoulder, at the rail
steps.direction: Stand behind the owner's shoulder and hold still while they pull their pick off the rail or shelf.

captions.script: Straight to this rail, no hesitation at all.
They knew exactly where it was.

steps.title: Why this one
steps.position: Facing the owner, the piece held up
steps.direction: Back camera on the owner holding the piece, front camera on you. Say what they told you about it.
steps.prompter: They say this is the piece they would keep for themselves.

captions.script: They say this is the piece they would keep for themselves.
Here is their reason, and why this one stands out.

steps.title: The price
steps.position: Same spot, the tag in your fingers
steps.direction: Phone straight above the tag, move down slowly until the price fills the screen.

captions.script: And the price on the tag, which made the choice easy.
Here is the tag, so you know exactly what it costs.

steps.title: On me
steps.position: In front of the shop mirror
steps.direction: Start with the phone close to the fabric you are now wearing, then lean back slowly to show the whole outfit.

captions.script: And here it is on me, the owner was right.
The fit, the colour, and I would not have picked it.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: By the counter, wearing the piece
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level. Say if you are keeping it.
steps.prompter: They were right, I would never have picked this off the rail myself.

captions.script: They were right, I would never have picked this off the rail myself.
Keeping it, and I am coming back for their next pick.

templates.title: Music shop demo
templates.summary: Staff play a few bars, the wall of instruments, you try the same one, their tip and the price.

steps.title: First chord
steps.position: Beside the staff member, phone above their hands
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the staff member's hands as they play the first chord. Keep it still.

captions.script: Listen to this before I tell you what it costs.
First chord on this one. Turn the sound up.

steps.title: The player
steps.position: In front of the staff member, a step away
steps.direction: Start close on their hands at eye level, then lean back slowly so the player and the instrument appear.

captions.script: Staff demo. Listen to how it sounds in the right hands.
A few bars from someone who actually knows how to play.

steps.title: The wall
steps.position: In front of the instrument wall
steps.direction: Phone at eye height, walk slowly sideways along the wall of instruments.

captions.script: The whole wall, with the prices on the tags.
Pick one off this wall and ask to try it.

steps.title: My turn
steps.position: Seated with the instrument, phone held above your hands
steps.direction: Back camera on your hands on the instrument, front camera on you. Play a few notes and say how it feels.
steps.prompter: I can barely play, but this one made me sound almost decent.

captions.script: I can barely play, but this one made me sound almost decent.
Trying it myself, and it is easier to play than mine.

steps.title: Staff tip
steps.position: Facing the staff member
steps.direction: Back camera on the staff member, front camera on you. Say the tip they gave you.
steps.prompter: Here is their tip for beginners, straight from behind the counter.

captions.script: Here is their tip for beginners, straight from behind the counter.
Best advice I got today, and it is simple.

steps.title: The price
steps.position: At the instrument, the tag in your fingers
steps.direction: Phone straight above the price tag on the instrument, move down slowly until the price fills the screen.

captions.script: Here is the price of the one I played, and where to find it.
This is what it costs to take this one home.

templates.title: Shop tour
templates.summary: Through the door, the main rail, the corner nobody notices, one find with its price, and the till.

steps.title: Walk in
steps.position: Outside, a few steps from the shop door
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, walk slowly up to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: Quick tour of a shop I keep coming back to.
Come in with me, here is what is inside.

steps.title: Inside
steps.position: Just inside the door
steps.direction: Start close on the first thing inside the door, then lean back slowly to show the whole shop.

captions.script: This is the whole shop, and every wall is full.
First look, and I know I will be here a while.

steps.title: Main rail
steps.position: At the main rail or wall
steps.direction: Hold the phone close to the rail, slide slowly along it and stop on one tag, then flick the phone right.

captions.script: Here is the price range on this rail, read off the tags.
The main rail. Here is how it is laid out.

steps.title: The corner
steps.position: In the back corner of the shop
steps.direction: Start mid-flick, slow down and keep turning slowly across the corner nobody notices.

captions.script: The corner nobody notices, and it has the best stuff.
Go all the way to the back, trust me.

steps.title: One find
steps.position: In the corner, a find in your hands
steps.direction: Phone above your hands, show one find from the corner and its price tag. Hold still.

captions.script: Found this back there, and here is what it costs.
Corner find, price on the tag, and it is mine.

steps.title: At the till
steps.position: At the till, the counter behind you
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the till behind you. Say where to start.
steps.prompter: Ask at the till about anything, and here is where to start.

captions.script: Ask at the till about anything, and here is where to start.
Here is when they are open, so plan your visit.

find.reads: The find grows toward the lens until the tag is readable; cut to the rail where it hung.

rail.reads: Hangers or spines slide past at an even pace and stop on the gap; cut to the label from above.

label.reads: The label fills the frame, held, then the frame flicks right onto the price tag.

tag.reads: The flick settles on the tag and holds; cut to the front camera.

why.reads: Face and find at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the shopfront.

shopfront.reads: The sign slides up out of frame and the door appears below it; hold for the outro.

pick.reads: The hand pulls the piece toward the lens; cut to the fabric and tag from above.

tag.reads: Fabric then tag fill the frame from above; cut to eye level at the changing room.

curtain.reads: The curtain grows until its fabric fills the frame; the next shot opens on the curtain sliding away.

reveal.reads: The curtain slides away and the outfit appears, one turn; match-cut on the creator to the mirror.

second.reads: Same place in frame, a different outfit, one turn; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face and both pieces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the sign outside.

sign.reads: The sign slides up and the door appears; hold for the outro.

budget.reads: Face and door at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the first pick.

pick-one.reads: The pick grows toward the lens until the tag reads; cut to eye level along the next shelf.

pick-two.reads: Items slide past and stop on pick two, then the frame flicks right.

pick-three.reads: The flick settles above the pick and its tag; cut to over the cashier's shoulder.

till.reads: The total grows until it fills the frame; the next shot starts on one tag and pulls back.

haul.reads: From one tag the frame rises until all three picks lie in it; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face and bag at arm's length, held still for the outro.

ask.reads: The owner grows in the back camera as the creator asks; cut to behind the owner at the rail.

pull.reads: Over the shoulder, the owner's hand finds the piece and lifts it; cut to the owner holding it up.

why.reads: The owner holds the piece up in the back camera, still; cut to the tag from above.

tag.reads: The tag grows until the fabric fills the frame; the next shot opens on the same fabric, worn.

try.reads: The fabric fills the frame, then the outfit appears around it; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face and outfit at arm's length, held still for the outro.

chord.reads: Fingers on the strings or keys fill the frame; the next shot starts on the same hands and pulls back.

player.reads: From the hands, the player and the instrument appear around them; cut to walking the wall.

wall.reads: Headstocks or keys slide past at an even pace; cut to above the creator's hands.

try.reads: The creator's hands play from above in the back camera; cut to the staff member at eye level.

tip.reads: The staff member in the back camera, held still while the creator speaks; cut to the price tag.

price.reads: The tag grows until the price fills the frame; hold for the outro.

door.reads: The door grows until it fills the frame; the next shot opens inside.

inside.reads: The first rack shrinks as the whole shop appears around it; cut close to the main rail.

rail.reads: Hangers slide past the lens and stop on a tag, then the frame flicks right into the corner.

corner.reads: The flick settles and the back corner turns past slowly; cut to one find from above.

find.reads: The find and its tag fill the frame from above; cut to the front camera at the till.

till.reads: Face and counter at arm's length, held still for the outro.
